findings.risk_interpretation: CLP harmonised EU classification: Acute Tox. 4 (H302), STOT SE 3 (H335), Eye Dam. 1 (H318). A hazard classification describes the pure substance; the risk for a consumer depends on its concentration in the product and on exposure, which the label does not give. The SCCS assessed its use in cosmetic products (SCCS/1575/16 Opinion on Phenoxyethanol).
